discrepancies.decision: Battle 26 follows tile_type, front banner and logical F back; printing metadata preserved.
Invention 4 follows tile_type, front scroll and logical F back; printing metadata preserved.
Planning row lists 6 Arches for 2 players; use printed 20 Arches and rules p3 five per player.
26/35/43 exclude five market dominos; retained deck plus market is 31/40/48.
